docs.title: Rudist
docs.text: A modern Redis GUI client built with Rust + egui.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Multi-tab connections
  • String, List, Hash, Set, ZSet support
  • JSON auto-format
  • Keyboard shortcuts
  • Async I/O, fast performance

docs.title: Connect
docs.text:
1. Click "+ New" in dropdown
  2. Enter host, port, password
  3. Save

docs.title: Browse Keys
docs.text:
• Left panel: key list (supports * wildcard)
  • Click key to view value

docs.title: Shortcuts
docs.text: Shortcut Action Ctrl+T New tab Ctrl+W Close tab Ctrl+R Refresh Ctrl+F Filter keys

docs.title: Command Line
docs.text: Type Redis commands at bottom, press Enter to execute.
